desc:
Cultivate qi, break through realms, and climb from Body Awakening in this 2D idle cultivation incremental. Refine your dao while offline, awaken bloodlines and talents, gather treasures, join a sect, and explore for loot all to rise to greater heights.

Recommended graphics level 3 or higher.

⚠️ In heavy development. Expect bugs, shutdowns, and frequent updates. There will be NO data resets.

Xianxia / cultivation genre. Inspired by Overmortal, the Er Gen universe, and
Regressor's Tale of Cultivation.
